S01: In the distant kingdom of Tsar Berendey, beside the splendid palace, grew an orchard full of golden apples.
S02: The golden apples shone like fire on the branches.
S03: But someone stole the apples at night, and the ruler was troubled.
S04: Tsar Berendey: "Son, keep watch tonight — someone is stealing our golden apples."
S05: Ivan: "I shall keep the watch, father, and I will find the thief."
S06: That night, Ivan sat under the tree with a lantern and waited.
S07: Hours passed, and the silence grew heavier.
S08: Suddenly, through the night flashed a radiant light — a bird of living fire.
S09: The firebird landed on a branch, glowing like a small sun.
S10: With its beak, it picked the golden apples one by one.
S11: Ivan crept closer, wishing to catch it.
S12: But he managed to pluck only a single feather from its tail.
S13: The bird spread its wings and vanished into the night sky.
S14: The feather glowed in Ivan's palm, warm as embers.
S15: Tsar Berendey: "Saddle the horse and bring me that bird!"
S16: At dawn, Ivan mounted his horse and set out in search.
S17: He traveled through dense forests and open fields.
S18: Suddenly, out of the bushes came a terrible grey wolf.
S19: The wolf leaped upon the horse before Ivan could react.
S20: The horse fell, and Ivan stood alone before the beast.
S22: Wolf: "I will make it up to you. I will take you to the bird you seek."
S23: Ivan climbed onto the wolf's back, trusting him.
S24: The wolf ran swift as the wind through forests and valleys.
S25: They reached the palace of Tsar Afron, where the bird was kept in a golden cage.
S26: Ivan followed the wolf's counsel and took the bird from the cage.
S27: But the guards seized him and brought him before the tsar.
S28: Tsar Afron: "I will give you the bird in exchange for the horse with the golden mane of Tsar Kusman."
S29: The wolf carried Ivan to the castle of Tsar Kusman.
S30: Ivan stole the horse with the golden mane from Kusman's stables.
S31: But this time too the guards caught him.
S32: Tsar Kusman: "I will give you the horse if you bring me the beautiful Elena, daughter of Tsar Dalmat."
S33: Wolf and Ivan traveled to the distant palace of Tsar Dalmat, to the high tower of the princess.
S34: The wolf found Princess Elena in the flower garden.
S35: Ivan was left breathless by her beauty.
S36: Ivan: "I do not want to live without this sweet girl... help me!"
S37: Wolf: "We will hide her in the forest, and then we will go before the tsar."
S38: Before the castle gates, the wolf transformed into the likeness of the beautiful Elena.
S39: Kusman gave Ivan the horse and welcomed the false princess.
S40: In the evening, when the tsar tried to embrace her, she became a wolf again and fled the castle.
S41: The wolf escaped and rejoined Ivan and the princess in the forest.
S42: Ivan: "I do not want to live without this splendid horse... help me!"
S43: The wolf used the same trick — he transformed into the horse with the golden mane.
S44: Ivan handed the false horse to Tsar Afron, and he gave him the bird.
S45: When Afron drew near, the false horse reared, threw the tsar, and ran back to Ivan.
S46: With all the gifts — Elena, the horse, and the firebird — Ivan set out for home.
S47: They welcomed him before the gates of the kingdom, radiant and victorious.
S48: Tsar Berendey proudly blessed his son and all the gifts.
S49: Ivan married the beautiful Elena, and the whole kingdom celebrated.
S50: And they never parted from the loyal, devoted grey wolf.
